title: Vine 49 | Kelowna Wine Tours

services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: Experience the ultimate Kelownafornia day. We start the day with a West Kelowna Half-Day Wine Tour where we take you to 4 beautiful wineries for a tasting flight at each. We finish the wine tour at Frind where you're picked up by boat to enjoy a 2 hour boat cruise on Okanagan Lake! Get ready for the first wine tasting at 11am, we’ll whisk you away in our comfy tour bus to explore the best of West Kelowna's wine country. Visit four renowned wineries, including the picturesque Mt. Boucherie, the volcanic flavors of Volcanic Hills, the hidden gem Black Swift, and the grand finale at Frind Estate Winery, nestled right on the lake.
